known_blockers.summary: EVERY Pages-Router route in this office app fails to hydrate on the client. Verified across /prediction-admin/settlements, /prediction-admin/markets, and /logs: the page+container+_app JS modules all evaluate, but NO React component renders client-side (AppComponent/SessionGuard/page/container render markers never fire), there are ZERO client errors (window.onerror + unhandledrejection + console.error all empty with _app.js suppression disabled), and no DOM node has a React fiber. Only SSR HTML is shown; effects never run; data never loads. App-Router routes (/auth/login, /dashboard, /audit-logs) hydrate fine. Root cause is at the Next Pages-Router CLIENT BOOTSTRAP itself — pages/_app.js modules evaluate but PhoenixApp/AppComponent never render. Stack: Next 16.2.2 + React 19.2.4 + legacy Pages Router (+ AntD 4.16, next-i18next ^14).
known_blockers.impact: Historical only for active office routes. Any reintroduced Pages-Router admin surface risks server-rendered but non-interactive UI: tables never populate, buttons/modals/forms do nothing. Keep new office work in app/ and delete or redirect legacy pages instead of reviving them.
known_blockers.not_the_cause: Ruled out, each EMPIRICALLY (not assumed): data/CORS (gateway returns 22 closed markets; raw fetch from page ctx OK); the useApi render-loop (fixed 4e148445); hydration text-mismatch (none captured); useApiHookTyped SSR pre-hooks early-return (fixed 6ab68903, clean-rebuilt, still dead); NEXT-I18NEXT/appWithTranslation (Codex-prescribed experiment 2026-05-18: `export default PhoenixApp` without the HOC -> STILL no hydration -> next-i18next is NOT the cause; the earlier 'next-i18next prime suspect' hypothesis is FALSIFIED); _app.getInitialProps (experiment: disabled it too, combined with no-HOC -> STILL no hydration). Remaining suspects (untested): Next 16/React 19 Pages-Router client bootstrap incompatibility, or the `react-dom$` webpack alias shim in next.config.js (~L86). Next experiment if pursued: PhoenixApp returning bare <Component {...pageProps}/> to isolate provider stack from framework bootstrap.
known_blockers.recommended_fix: Architectural: migrate the prediction-admin Pages-Router pages to the App Router (the office's active tree per root CLAUDE.md). Independently confirmed by Codex (2026-05-18, repo-inspected): Option A (migrate) is correct; Option B (fix Pages bootstrap) is now effectively NON-VIABLE — with next-i18next AND _app.getInitialProps both eliminated, B means resolving a Next-16/React-19 legacy-Pages-Router framework bootstrap failure, strictly worse than migrating. Re-scope warning (Codex): the container logic is reusable but the RUNTIME ENVELOPE is the real work — AntD CSS is only in pages/_app.js (app/layout.tsx lacks antd.css), App Router does not mount Redux/Theme/SessionGuard/MenuProvider, do NOT reuse the legacy <Layout> (use the app dashboard shell), securedPage getInitialProps is not portable (needs middleware/cookie or client guard), and plan the pages/->app/ route-collision delete in the same migration. styled-components is NOT a risk (app/lib/styled-components-registry.tsx already exists). Do NOT attempt under time pressure or unsupervised on the deployed branch.
